definition: household works; the work of a house-keeper.
example_en: She was engaged in household work since morning.

definition: (used in comp.) that which or he who eats too much and greedily.
example: ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಮುಕ್ಕ, ಊಟ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ತೃಪ್ತಿಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He is a glutton, never satisfied while eating.

definition: a written statement, account, declaration, assertion or explanation.
example_en: The judge examined the witnesses' written statements.

definition: a companion or friend.
example_en: He continued the journey along with his companion.

definition: a male servant or slave.
example_en: The male servant worked at the house all night.

definition: a frying pan.
example_en: That frying pan was heating over the fire.

definition: an upward slope of ground; acclivity.
example_en: The upward slope of the hill was very difficult to climb.

definition: causing fear; frightful, hideous; ghastly.
example: ಆ ಅಕ್ರಾಳವಿಕ್ರಾಳ ರಾಕ್ಷಸನನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಹೆದರಿದರು.
example_en: The children were frightened upon seeing that hideous demon.

definition: a symbol for the number nine.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಶಾಸನದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಾವಕ ಎಂಬ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾ ಸಂಕೇತ ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: In the old inscription, the numeral symbol chavaka has been used for nine.

definition: to lose, abandon (one's) sign, mark, etc.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಸೋಲಿನ ಬಳಿಕ ತನ್ನ ಕುಱುಹುದೊಱೆದನು.
example_en: After the defeat, that person lost his own mark of identity.

definition: a container for food or cooking vessel.
example_en: They had kept the cooking vessel in the kitchen.

definition: an opposing or contradicting statement or argument.
example_en: His contradicting statement stirred up debate in the assembly.

definition: to weaken; to cause to become frail or feeble.
example_en: The long illness weakened his body.

definition: amounting to one hundred twenty five thousand.
example_en: The value of his property amounted to one hundred twenty five thousand rupees.

definition: a man who sells perfumes.
example_en: The perfume seller's shop had various kinds of fragrances.

definition: a charitable act or generous gift; a help; a service; a favour; an obligation.
example: ಅವನ ಉಪಕೃತಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬವನ್ನು ಸಂಕಷ್ಟದಿಂದ ಪಾರುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His favour rescued our family from hardship.

definition: a kind or gracious act; any thing bestowed graciously.
example: ದೇವರ ಪಸದ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಬಾಳಿಗೆ ಒಳಿತು ತರಲಿ.
example_en: May God's gracious blessing bring good to everyone's life.

definition: to become pitiable; to become miserably humble.
example_en: Having lost, he became pitiable and begged for forgiveness.

definition: a publicising secretly.
example_en: That organization was engaged in secret publicity.

definition: a narrow street or lane.
example_en: Children were playing in the lane behind the house.

definition: to make a fold in a garment to shorten or decorate; to tuck.
example_en: Grandmother tucked a fold in her sari and wore it neatly.

definition: to raise one's hand.
example_en: The boy who knew the answer raised his hand.

definition: a man who sees; an observer; a seer.
example: ಆ ಘಟನೆಯ ದಿಟ್ಟಿಗ ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The observer of that incident gave evidence to the police.

definition: the act of eating grass; grazing.
example_en: The cattle's grazing ended after evening.

definition: certainly; without doubt.
example_en: She certainly spoke the truth.

definition: red; reddish; copper-coloured.
example_en: The reddish copper color of that cloth was beautiful.

definition: the quality or fact of being deep (usu. being difficult to measure the depth).
example_en: It was impossible to measure the ocean's depth.

definition: to convey an information, idea etc. through spoken words; to tell.
example_en: He does not tell his secret to anyone.

definition: a past incident, event or story narrated or portrayed at a later time inturrupting the continuity of the main story, play, movie, etc.
example: ನಾಟಕದ ನಡುವೆ ಹಿಂಗತೆಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಿ ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಕರನ್ನು ಗೊಂದಲಕ್ಕೀಡುಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They showed a flashback in the middle of the play and confused the audience.

definition: a group of robbers who plunder the wayfarers.
example_en: The band of robbers plundered the travellers.

definition: to overcome the feeling of abhorrence.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಪೇಸುಗೆಗೆಡುತ್ತಾ ಆ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He overcame his abhorrence and did that work.

definition: in a dim manner; dimly; dully.
example_en: The evening light had spread dimly.

definition: a kind of small insect.
example_en: The small insect sits on the wall and bites.

definition: the plant Basella rubra of Basellaceae family; Indian spinach.
example_en: The red Indian spinach had grown well in the garden.

definition: to use, wield a weapon; to hit, injure or kill another with a weapon.
example_en: The soldiers are wielding weapons and guarding the border.

definition: hurriedly; urgently; immediately; without delay.
example_en: Come quickly and bring the doctor without delay.

definition: to become a coagulated mass; to become thickened; to be clotted.
example_en: The blood clotted near the wound.

definition: of the colour of coal or pitch; black or almost black.
example_en: That black dog is running.

definition: (moisture, water, present inside) to dry up.
example_en: Due to the heat of the sun, the moisture inside the wall dried up.

definition: a yellow to dark brown, addicting, narcotic drug prepared from the juice of the unripe seed capsules of the opium poppy, which contains such alkaloids as morphine, codeine, and papaverine, and is used as an intoxicant and medicinally to relieve pain and produce sleep; opium.
example_en: The police stopped the smuggling of opium at the border.

definition: in a pleasing, gentle manner; beautifully.
example_en: She welcomed us, smiling in a gentle, pleasing manner.

definition: to fall upon; to attack; to invade.
example_en: The enemies fell upon the village at dawn.

definition: an encouraging or being encouraged; encouragement.
example_en: The teacher's encouragement gave the students strength.

definition: a confidential information which is not accessible to an outsider; inside information.
example_en: That officer did not disclose the inside information to anyone.

definition: a man engaged in farming for his living; a farmer; an agriculturist.
example_en: That farmer was working in the field since morning.

definition: to break or split, usu. without complete separation of parts; to develop a crack.
example_en: A strong blow struck the wall and it developed a crack.

definition: an elderly man.
example_en: That elderly man was respected by everyone in the village.

definition: he who stabs.
example_en: That stabber was caught by the police.

definition: an inhabitant of or a person habitually wanders in a forest; a forester.
example: ಕಾಡಾಡಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ದಿನ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೆಕ್ಕಿ ತರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The forester used to gather fruits every day.

definition: a heavy iron block used by smiths to hammer heated metals and to give desired shape; an anvil.
example: ಕಮ್ಮಾರ ಅಡಿಗಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಂಪಗಿನ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣವನ್ನು ಬಡಿದನು.
example_en: The smith hammered the red-hot iron on the anvil.

definition: the condition of non existing; non-existence.
example_en: The non-existence of ghosts was convincing to him.

definition: a woman who hates, abhors, abominates men as a whole (with or without reason) and complains that men are the main or sole, cause for womeṇs woes and griefs.
example_en: Being a man-hater, she trusts no man at all.

definition: a particle of negation or word expressing the idea of the word 'no' of English; not.
example_en: This is not right, that is not it.

definition: towards outside.
example_en: People gathered towards outside the temple.

definition: to speak imperfectly or like a child; to lisp.
example_en: The child speaks lisping.

definition: to be aware of as something or someone known before or as the same as that known; to recognise.
example_en: He recognised his old friend.

definition: (masc.) one who does injustice, commits wrong to others.
example: ಆ ಅನ್ನೆಕಾರ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಸದಾ ಅನ್ಯಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That wrongdoer always did injustice to the poor.

definition: to sprout as from a spore, seed, etc.; to germinate.
example_en: After the rain fell, the seed sprouted.

definition: that which is particular to a region, place or country.
example_en: This festival is our regional tradition.

definition: the act or an instance of making (something) into powder; pulverisation.
example_en: The pulverisation of the sandalwood spread fragrance everywhere.

definition: the creeper Ichnocarpus frutescens of Apocynaceae family.
example_en: The hālugeṇasu creeper had spread at the edge of the forest.

definition: a man addicted or being enslaved to a habit or practice obsessively; an addict.
example_en: That addict could not free himself from the obsession of cards.

definition: a disease marked by violent, involuntary contraction or spasm of the muscles; convulsions.
example_en: He got convulsions and his body shook.

definition: the government policy relating to promotion, control of industries and industrialisation; industrial policy.
example_en: The government announced a new industrial policy.

definition: a head wih disheveled hair.
example_en: Her disheveled head of hair was even more tousled in the wind.

definition: (used as an interrogative) what one (or ones) of the number of persons, things or events mentioned or implied? which?
example_en: Which book are you reading?

definition: a shirt with sleeves covering only the upper arm (upto the elbow).
example_en: He wears a half-sleeved shirt in summer.

definition: to boil well.
example_en: Mother boiled the milk well and made it ready.

definition: a spathe of the plantain inflorescence.
example_en: There was a spathe around the plantain flower cluster.

definition: a female cat (Felic cattus of Felidae family).
example_en: The female cat was sleeping in the corner of the house.

definition: the work of weaving fabrics on looms.
example_en: Grandfather is an expert in the weaving of baskets.

definition: a getting up; a rising.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಜೊತೆ ಜನರ ಸಮುತ್ಥಾನ ಆರಂಭವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The people's rising began with the morning sun.

definition: a bundle of straws, hay or grass.
example_en: They carried a bundle of hay for the cattle.

definition: to pass a period of time.
example_en: He passed his time in the town.

definition: emitting; emanating.
example_en: Emanating gases rose from the mountain into the sky.

definition: visually perceived; seen.
example_en: That scene was seen by everyone.

definition: the quality or fact of being lively; liveliness.
example_en: The child's liveliness made everyone happy.

definition: a small container for keeping ink; an ink pot.
example_en: The writer dipped the pen in the ink pot.

definition: zinc sulphate; white vitriol.
example_en: The blacksmith coated the metal with zinc sulphate.

definition: the leader of a group of people.
example: ಆ ಗಣಪ ತನ್ನ ತಂಡವನ್ನು ಜಾಣ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: That leader guided his group wisely.

definition: a kind of musical composition.
example_en: They performed the musical composition at the festival.

definition: the wish or desire to speak or declare.
example_en: The poet's wish to express was clear in those lines.

definition: to give a name or title to; to name.
example_en: The grandfather named the grandchild Krishna.

definition: a multitude or cluster of stars.
example_en: A multitude of stars spread across the sky.

definition: a serious plot, secret scheme or conspiracy.
example: ಅವರು ರಾಜನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಒಂದು ವಿಸಂಚ ಹೂಡಿದರು.
example_en: They hatched a conspiracy against the king.

definition: hair growing on the scalp.
example_en: Her hair was long and black.

definition: to become uncertain, hesitant, confused or puzzled; to be perplexed.
example: ಕಠಿಣ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಕೆಲ್ಲೈಸಿದನು.
example_en: The boy became perplexed on being asked the difficult question.

definition: a wild, lawless person, often a member of a gang of criminals; hoodlum.
example_en: A hoodlum was quarreling on the street.

definition: to receive appreciation, compliment from another.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಮುಂದೆ ಪಾಠ ಒಪ್ಪಿಸಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The student recited the lesson before the teacher and received appreciation.

definition: developing; causing to expand or causing to become bigger.
example: ಈ ಔಷಧಿ ಬೆಳೆಯ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ಪರಿವರ್ಧಕವಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This medicine works as a developer for the crop's growth.

definition: the bony case of the brain of a vertebrate; the skull.
example_en: His skull was injured in the accident.

definition: the sharp, short sound made by snapping a finger with the thumb.
example: ಅವನು ಬೆರಳಿನ ಚಿಟಿಕೆ ಹೊಡೆದು ಆಳನ್ನು ಕರೆದನು.
example_en: He snapped his fingers with a chitike sound and called the servant.

definition: the action of neglecting.
example: ಕೆಲಸದ ಹೈಗೈ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬೈಗುಳ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: He was scolded for neglecting the work.

definition: marvel - a) a thing or person or an event that is very surprising or causes a lot of admiration; b) a feeling of great surprise and admiration caused by seeing or experiencing something that is strange and new; wonder.
example_en: His artwork seemed a marvel to everyone who saw it.

definition: to surround or cover entirely.
example_en: The mist covered the entire hill completely.

definition: a book, treatise of which the text is written on palmyra leaves.
example_en: An ancient palmyra-leaf manuscript is displayed in the library.

definition: the act of carrying a load, burden on one's head, shoulders or back.
example_en: That laborer carried the load of bricks.

definition: a receptacle made by a bird for its eggs and young; a nest.
example: ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀಡ ಕಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The bird built a nest on the branch of the tree.

definition: that cannot be avoided or evaded; unavoidable; inevitable; certain to happen.
example_en: This change was unavoidable.

definition: the vine Ipomoea digitata of Convolvulaceae family.
example_en: The vine of the Ipomoea digitata plant climbed up the tree.

definition: (dial.) a learned man; a scholar.
example: ಊರಿನ ಪಳೆಂಕರು ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೇದಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The scholars of the town spoke about the Vedas at the assembly.

definition: to be smeared, anointed with; to be painted.
example_en: The wall had been nicely smeared with lime.

definition: a standard letter of a language.
example_en: The children are learning to write the standard letters.

definition: midday; noon.
example_en: At midday, the sun is intensely hot.

definition: the thistle plant Argemone mexicana of Papaveraceae family; gamboge thistle.
example_en: Thistle plants have grown all along the fence.

definition: the thorny bush Plectronia parviflora (= Canthium parviflorum) of Rubiaceae family.
example_en: Kāre thorny bushes had grown all along the field's fence.

definition: not opposing; non-combative; compatible; congruous.
example_en: The relationship between the two of them is compatible.

definition: inviolable - a) not to be violated; not to be profaned or injured; sacred; b) that cannot be violated; indestructible.
example_en: The rule of this temple is inviolable.

definition: cheerful talking; joyful speech.
example_en: Cheerful talk was going on between the two of them.

definition: the second marriage of a woman (following the death of her earlier husband); a widow marriage.
example_en: Widow remarriage had been discussed in the book.

definition: to estimate the probable quantity, measurement, etc.
example_en: He suggested to estimate the expenses.

definition: to be and look beautiful.
example_en: She looks beautiful in this dress.

definition: making false claim or show; behaving in an artificial way to impress or deceive people.
example_en: People were deceived by his false, pretentious behavior.

definition: a house having a potter's kiln.
example_en: The potter was baking pots in his kiln-house.

definition: water perfumed with musk.
example_en: They had filled the palace bathing pool with water perfumed with musk.

definition: money kept for times of need or put aside as a reserve; reserve fund.
example_en: The family had saved a reserve fund for times of emergency.

definition: a talking about looting of something.
example_en: Talk of looting is widespread in the village.

definition: the means of sustaining life; livelihood.
example_en: Farming was the basis of his livelihood.

definition: a fat, corpulent man.
example: ಆ ಡೊಳ್ಳ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದೂರ ನಡೆದರೂ ಏದುಸಿರು ಬಿಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That fat man panted for breath even after walking a short distance.

definition: a toothed instrument for separating and cleaning hair; comb.
example_en: She combed her hair with a comb.

definition: a corn or seed that is capable of being used for reproduction.
example: ರೈತ ಉತ್ತಮ ಗಟ್ಟಿಕಾಳನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ಬಿತ್ತನೆಗೆ ಇಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The farmer selected good seed grain and kept it for the next sowing.

definition: (a prostitute) to take or receive money from her paramour.
example_en: That prostitute took money from her paramour.

definition: the wife of an astrologer.
example_en: The astrologer's wife was standing in front of her house.

definition: a person with pleasing musical voice.
example_en: Being a person with a pleasing musical voice, he sang the song sweetly.

definition: pressure - a) a pressing or being pressed; compression; squeezing; b) the pressure due to the weight; c) a condition of distress; oppression; affliction; d) a sense impression caused by or as by compression of a part of the body; e) a compelling influence; constraining force; f) a demand for immediate attention; urgency.
example_en: The pressure of work had increased on him.

definition: a grant of money for some purpose.
example_en: The government gave financial assistance to poor students.

definition: a rectangular piece of hardboard, with or without a clip, used as a rigid support, kept under a sheet of paper to write on; a pad.
example_en: While writing, I keep a pad under the paper.

definition: small in size; not big, large or great.
example_en: This box is small in size.

definition: to prepare rice-gruel or porridge.
example_en: Grandmother prepared rice-gruel in the morning.

definition: a stewardess in a passenger aircraft; an air-hostess.
example_en: The air-hostess served food to the passengers on the flight.

definition: a non-contagious skin disorder of unknown cause, characterised by inflammation, itching, and the formation of scales; eczema.
example: ಅವನ ಕಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದರ್ದು ಎದ್ದು ಚರ್ಮ ಕೆಂಪಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Eczema had broken out on his leg and the skin had reddened.

definition: the plant Dolichos lablab ( = Lablab niger) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The farmers grew the lablab bean crop in the field.

definition: to become exhausted, fatigued.
example_en: Having worked the whole day, he became exhausted.

definition: a burial ground or a place where dead bodies are cremated; a graveyard, cemetery or crematory.
example_en: There was an old burial ground on the outskirts of the village.

definition: the thunder-like sound made by pulling the string of a bow and releasing it suddenly.
example: ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನ ಹೆದೆಯನ್ನು ಎಳೆದು ಬಿಟ್ಟಾಗ ಜ್ಯಾರಾವ ಕೇಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: When the bowstring was pulled and released, a thunder-like sound was heard.

definition: suppressed, but potent anger.
example_en: A trace of suppressed anger appeared on her face.

definition: the plant Asparagus falcatus of Liliaceae family.
example_en: The ajjigadde creeper had spread at the edge of the forest.

definition: to cut; to severe.
example_en: Cut the firewood and burn it.

definition: a small hill or mound; a hillock.
example_en: A small hillock can be seen outside the village.

definition: handsomeness (of the body).
example_en: Her handsome form attracted everyone's attention.

definition: a place of learning, as a school, college, etc.
example_en: A new school was opened in this town.

definition: the state of being related to another or connection between persons, by blood, marriage, etc.; relation; kinship.
example: ಆ ಎರಡು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಪಕ್ಕೂವಣಿತನ ತಲೆಮಾರುಗಳಿಂದ ಇದೆ.
example_en: Kinship between those two families has existed for generations.

definition: a plant of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The large milk-pumpkin plant had spread along the garden fence.

definition: a type of black stone formerly used to test the purity of gold or silver by the streak left on it when it was rubbed with the metal; a touchstone.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಒರೆಗಲ್ಲಿನಿಂದ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಶುದ್ಧತೆಯನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In olden days, they used to test the purity of gold with a touchstone.

definition: broad shoulders (of a strong, well-built man).
example: ಆ ಪೈಲ್ವಾನನ ಸಿಂಗಮುಯ್ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That wrestler's broad shoulders drew everyone's attention.

definition: an administrative officer.
example: ಆ ಕಚೇರಿಯ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕೆಲಸಗಾರರನ್ನು ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಣೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The director of that office supervises all the workers.

definition: without pause or delay; at once; instantly; immediately.
example_en: He went home at once.

definition: the vine Coccinia Cordifolia (=C. indica, = Bryonia grandis, = Momordica monadelpha) of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: They brought the ivy gourd needed for cooking from the garden.

definition: a chequered or colourful carpet.
example_en: A colourful carpet had been spread in the middle of the pavilion.

definition: divine service; worship.
example_en: Worship service takes place at the mosque every Friday.

definition: the science of numbers; arithmetic.
example_en: The clerk used knowledge of arithmetic for the accounts.

definition: the condition of being crushed, squashed.
example: ಟ್ರಕ್ ಹಾದುಹೋಗಿ ಬುಟ್ಟಿಯ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳ ನಜ್ಜು ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the truck passed over, the fruits in the basket were crushed.

definition: the vine Cucumis callosus ( = C. trigonus) of Cucurbiaceae family.
example_en: The farmer grew the hālumekke vine in the garden.

definition: a band of electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths between gamma rays and ultraviolet radiation (c. .005 to c. 5 nanometres), capable of penetrating opaque or solid substances, ionizing gases and body tissues through which they pass or, by extended exposure, destroying tissue, and affecting photographic plates and fluorescent screens, used in medicine for study, diagnosis, and treatment of certain organic disorders, esp. of internal structures of the body; X-ray.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಮೂಳೆ ಮುರಿತ ಪತ್ತೆಗೆ ಎಕ್ಸ್ ರೇ ತೆಗೆಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor got an X-ray taken to detect the bone fracture.

definition: a graduated stick or rod one yard in length, used in measuring; a yard-stick.
example_en: At school they measure the length of the floor with a yardstick.

definition: unsettled, confusing or disorderly condition.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅನವಸ್ಥಾಪ್ರಸಂಗ ಉಂಟಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಗೊಂದಲಗೊಂಡರು.
example_en: A confusing, disorderly situation arose in that house and everyone was bewildered.

definition: a sage who leads an ascetic life in pursuit of philosophical truth.
example_en: That sage taught knowledge to his disciples.

definition: competent; capable; fit.
example_en: He is a competent person fit for that work.

definition: one of two or more persons who own a piece of property, each having an undivided right of possession; a co-tenant.
example_en: Both of them are co-tenants of that land.

definition: one time, occasion only; once.
example_en: I went to meet him only once.

definition: any of a genus (Ocimum) of fragrant plants of the mint family, esp. a white-flowered garden herb (Ocimum sanctum which is religiously regarded as a goddess).
example_en: The juice of holy basil leaves is good for a cough.

definition: to resist or rise against some authority, control or tradition; to revolt; to rebel.
example_en: The people decided to rebel against the injustice.

definition: full of force and speed; powerful and swift.
example_en: That horse ran with powerful and swift movement.

definition: (the body) to grow, develop toward maturity.
example_en: The child's body grew toward maturity over the years.

definition: curd, from which water content is completely strained.
example_en: The grandmother prepared strained curd by filtering it through cloth.

definition: the red glow of twilight.
example_en: The red glow of twilight reddened the sky.

definition: something lent, esp. a sum of money lent; a loan.
example_en: He took a small loan from his friend.

definition: a kind of medicinal substance made using the plant Adhatoda vasica.
example_en: The physician prepared the medicinal substance made from the Adhatoda vasica plant.

definition: a piece of land higher than adjacent land; a natural elevation of land.
example: ಆ ತಿಂಟೆಯ ಮೇಲಿಂದ ಊರು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The village was clearly visible from that elevated ground.

definition: a particular medicine used for curing delirium.
example_en: The doctor gave the patient the sūcakābharaṇa rasa medicine.

definition: the creator of the universe; the Supreme Being.
example_en: The Creator of the universe made all living beings.

definition: a man belonging to a nomadic sect, main occupation of the members of which is mat-weaving and bamboo-basket making.
example_en: That nomadic bamboo-basket weaver was weaving baskets from bamboo.

definition: pleasure; joy.
example_en: She found joy in the children's play.

definition: a pouring or sprinkling of water.
example_en: They sprinkled water in the courtyard before the worship.

definition: good conduct; righteous conduct.
example_en: That boy's good conduct was admired by everyone.

definition: the state of being dim; dimness; the time of the evening when it is starts becoming dark.
example_en: In the dim, gathering dusk of evening, the birds returned to their nests.

definition: the natural source of a stream; a oozing of usu. water from underground; something that oozes.
example_en: A natural source of water was found at the foot of the hill.

definition: an entrance; a door.
example_en: The palace's entrance door was very tall.

definition: to construct a road, path.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರವು ಹಳ್ಳಿಗೆ ಹೊಸ ದಾರಿಮಾಡುವ ಕೆಲಸ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The government started constructing a new road to the village.

definition: having no petals.
example: ಈ ಗಿಡವು ಅದಳ ಜಾತಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿದ್ದು, ಹೂವಿಗೆ ದಳಗಳಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: This plant belongs to the petal-less kind; the flower has no petals.

definition: the finger nearest to the thumb; the index finger; the forefinger.
example_en: He showed the way with his index finger.

definition: fish processed using salt as a preservative.
example_en: He bought salted fish at the shop and brought it home.

definition: sweet talk that is capable of winning favour or cheating.
example: ಅವನ ಪಗಂಟಿಗೆ ಮರುಳಾಗಿ ಅವಳು ಹಣ ಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: Falling for his sweet, cheating talk, she gave him money.

definition: thick; stout; fat.
example: ಹೀವರವಾದ ದೇಹದ ಆ ಪೈಲ್ವಾನ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆದನು.
example_en: That wrestler with a stout body drew everyone's attention.

definition: a high-speed water current.
example_en: Swimming in the high-speed water current is dangerous.

definition: difficulty - a) the condition or fact of being difficult; b) something that is difficult, as a hard problem or an obstacle or objection.
example: ಈ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಟ್ಟ ಬಂದರೆ ನಾವು ತಡವಾಗಿ ತಲುಪುತ್ತೇವೆ.
example_en: If we face difficulty on this road, we will arrive late.

definition: to think of dying (oneself) or killing or desroying something.
example_en: Burdened by debt, he was thinking of dying.

definition: all; the whole extent of quantiy of.
example_en: This is a matter known to all the people.

definition: much hotness; great warmth.
example: ಒಲೆಯ ಬಳಿ ನಿಂತರೆ ಧಗೆ ಮೈಗೆ ತಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If one stands near the stove, the great heat touches the body.

definition: a person devoid of judgement or discretion.
example_en: That person devoid of judgement cannot tell right from wrong.

definition: the land that is situated below the level of a water tank (i.e. fed by the tank).
example: ಈ ಕಿೞ್ಕೆಱೆಗೆ ಕೆಱೆಯ ನೀರು ಹರಿದು ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Water from the tank flows into this land below the tank.

definition: something that makes sure or gives assurance, as against loss, damage or default; security; guarantee.
example: ಸಾಲ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಆಂದಿ ಬೇಕಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: He needed a guarantee to take the loan.

definition: the act, the practice or an instance of robbing; robbery.
example_en: A robbery took place in the village that night.

definition: a hurrying; hasteness.
example_en: The passengers ran in haste to catch the train.

definition: the fact of having passed a hurdle, difficult situation or examination.
example: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಉತ್ತೀರ್ಣತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸಂತೋಷ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His success in the examination brought joy to everyone.

definition: an act; an action; a deed; a work.
example: ಅವನ ಈ ಕರಣ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಪಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: This deed of his won everyone's appreciation.

definition: to write or draw a figure, picture.
example: ಕಲಾವಿದನು ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಸುಂದರ ಚಿತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The artist drew a beautiful picture on the wall.

definition: to be agitated, disturbed greatly.
example_en: Hearing the news of the riot, the people got greatly agitated.

definition: associated, united neatly and perfectly.
example_en: His thoughts came together neatly and perfectly.

definition: (literally) seven steps.
example_en: She stepped back seven steps.

definition: keen desire; eagerness.
example_en: Eagerness was clearly visible in her eyes.

definition: afflicted by pain, sorrow, distress, etc.
example_en: The mother, afflicted by sorrow over her son's death, did not speak.

definition: a long-handled brush of straws, twigs, bristles, etc. for sweeping; a broom.
example_en: She held the broom and swept the courtyard.

definition: to be kind; to have mercy.
example_en: The guru was kind and merciful towards his disciples.

definition: a herd of elephants.
example_en: A herd of elephants was moving slowly through the forest.

definition: a dexterous, skilful man.
example_en: The skilful man carved the wood in one go.

definition: an envious man.
example: ಅಸೂಯಕನಾದ ಅವನು ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನ ಸಂಪತ್ತನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಕುದಿದನು.
example_en: Being an envious man, he boiled with jealousy at the sight of his friend's wealth.

definition: a triangular prism of glass or the like for resolving light into separate colours.
example_en: A prism is used to separate light into colours.

definition: made or produced some time ago; not new; old.
example_en: Do not eat this stale (old) rice.

definition: a thing used as a decorative item on apparels.
example_en: They have tied a decorative item on the edge of her saree.

definition: a pillow or soft pad for sitting or kneeling on or reclining against; a cusion.
example: ಅವಳು ಕವುಳುಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She sat on the soft cushion and performed the worship.

definition: proud; boastful; inclined to brag.
example: ಅವನು ತಲೆಮೆಱೆಯಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He spoke boastfully about his achievements.

definition: an expert in the science of the universe in which the stars, planets, etc. are studied, including their origins, evolution, composition, motions, relative positions, sizes, etc.; an astronomer.
example: ಆ ಗಗನವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ಚಲನೆಯನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That astronomer studies the movement of the stars.

definition: the movable, muscular structure in the mouth in most vertebrates used for ingestion of food, perception of taste, and in humans for the articulation of speech sounds; the tongue.
example_en: Her tongue longed for the sweet dish.

definition: to wear a helmet, protective head-armour.
example: ರಣರಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಮೊದಲು ಆ ವೀರ ಸೀಸಕಂದಾಳ್ದನು.
example_en: Before going to the battlefield, that warrior wore the helmet.

definition: utter failure; the state of being frustrated.
example: ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಸೋತು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮುಕ್ಕಂಡೆಯ ಭಾವನೆ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: Failing repeatedly, he felt utter frustration.

definition: forcefully; powerfully; vigorously (often with rudeness).
example_en: He pushed the door forcefully.

definition: a woman lacking feminine qualities or characteristics.
example: ಆ ಬರಡಿಗೆ ಸ್ತ್ರೀಸಹಜ ಗುಣಗಳಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: People said that woman lacks feminine qualities.

definition: an administrative division of a state; a district.
example_en: That district comprised several villages.

definition: the art of dance.
example_en: She learned the art of dance from her childhood.

definition: a woman with abnormal curvature of the spine; a hump-backed woman.
example: ಕೂನಿ ತನ್ನ ಮಗಳ ಜೊತೆ ಸಂತೆಗೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: The hump-backed woman had come to the market with her daughter.

definition: (an abscess, boil, etc.) to form.
example_en: An abscess formed at the wound.

definition: the old name of a country in the coastal Andhra Pradesh.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ವೆಂಗಿ ಆಂಧ್ರ ಕರಾವಳಿಯ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ನಾಡಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In ancient times, Vengi was a famous country on the Andhra coast.

definition: the chief official in charge of official records.
example_en: The chief records officer has kept all the documents safely.

definition: a most stupid woman.
example_en: That most stupid woman did not listen to anyone.

definition: the act of touching; a physical contact.
example_en: His touch was gentle.

definition: excessive indulgence in sexual enjoyments; dissipation; debauchery.
example_en: His debauched life ruined him.

definition: wealth; riches.
example_en: Wealth was overflowing in that house.

definition: a variety of fresh water fish.
example_en: The freshwater fish lives in the freshwater lake.

definition: complete destruction; annihilation.
example_en: That flood caused the complete destruction of the village.

definition: to communicate through spoken words; to tell; to utter; to say.
example_en: The saint told the truth to the people.

definition: any of an order (Phoenicopteriformes) of large, tropical birds with long, red legs, webbed feet, long necks, downward-curving, red beaks, and bright pink or red feathers; a kind of flamingo.
example_en: A flock of flamingos was flying in the distance.

definition: to take into one's control; to seize; to capture.
example_en: The soldiers seized the enemy.

definition: one who repents; a repenter.
example_en: The repentant person who had erred asked for forgiveness.

definition: to grasp; to hold; to seize.
example_en: She grasped the child's hand.

definition: together; in association with.
example_en: Let us all eat together.

definition: a bar to fasten a door; a door-locking beam; a bolt.
example: ಅವನು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಮಲಗುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಬಾಗಿಲಿಗೆ ಅಗುೞಿ ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: He bolted the door before going to sleep at night.

definition: that much quantity which could be pounded at a time in a mortar.
example_en: She pounded one mortarful of rice in the mortar.

definition: the tree Syzygium malabaricum (= Eugenia malabarica) of Myrtaceae family.
example_en: The Syzygium malabaricum tree bears sweet fruits.

definition: to regulate; to bring under control, check; to restrain.
example_en: The government tried to regulate the prices.

definition: deep trouble or misery.
example_en: That family was caught in the deep misery of poverty.

definition: to make short, continuous bursting sounds.
example_en: The firecracker burst, making short, continuous bursting sounds.

definition: causing mental pain or distress; vexing; tormenting.
example_en: His words were tormenting to my mind.

definition: to become sharpened, honed.
example: ಕುಡುಗೋಲನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಉಜ್ಜಿ ಚೂರ್ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He rubbed the sickle on the stone and made it sharpened.

definition: (a crack, fissure) to grow more in depth or length.
example_en: Due to the rain the crack in the wall grew deeper.

definition: to clasp in the arms, usu. as an expression of affection or desire; to hug; to embrace.
example_en: The father embraced his son with affection.

definition: a particular kind of service to the god in a temple.
example_en: The priest performed the special service to the deity in the temple.

definition: an ornament for an elephant's ear.
example_en: A silver ornament had been fitted to the elephant's ear.

definition: a crucial vote or opinion that decides final outcome of a discussion, judgement or decision by a group, etc.
example_en: The chairman's crucial vote decided the meeting's outcome.

definition: the tree Citrus medica of Rutaceae family; Citron.
example_en: The citron tree in the garden was full of fruits.

definition: a watch tower raised in a crop field.
example: ರೈತ ಬೆಳೆ ಕಾಯಲು ಅಟ್ಟಣಿಗೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತನು.
example_en: The farmer sat on the watch tower (aṭṭaṇige) to guard the crop.

definition: a painteṛs brush.
example_en: The painter drew a beautiful picture with his brush.

definition: in or to a greater degree or extent.
example_en: His sorrow increased to a greater degree.

definition: luxurious, exuberant growth (of crop, wealth, etc.).
example_en: There has been a luxuriant crop in the field this year.

definition: a round metal container.
example_en: They used the round metal container for oil in the kitchen.

definition: (the chest, heart) to suffer from a pain.
example_en: His chest suffered a pain from worry.

definition: to become more in number, quantity, size, intensity, etc.
example_en: This year the prices increased a great deal.

definition: the act of praising, extolling or flattering.
example_en: He felt proud on hearing the people's praise.

definition: moving forward or onward; progressing; advancing.
example_en: This grew into a progressing movement.

definition: extreme heat.
example_en: The extreme afternoon heat of summer was unbearable.

definition: the gliding gait of a horse.
example_en: The horse's gliding gait attracted the onlookers.

definition: absence of duplicity; the quality, state or fact of being one; uniqueness.
example: ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಅದ್ವಿತ್ವವಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Everyone says that there is a oneness between the two of them.

definition: a kind of reed, Typha angustata of Typhaceae family; reed mace; elephant grass.
example_en: We saw the reed mace standing in the water.

definition: an inflamed swelling of a lymph node, esp. in the groin; a bubo.
example: ತೊಡೆಯ ಬಳಿ ತೊಡೆವಾಳ ಎದ್ದು ಜ್ವರ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: A bubo swelled near the groin and fever set in.

definition: a person employed to perform services, esp. personal or household duties, for another; a servant.
example_en: The servant was doing all the work of the house.

definition: a machine for use in working wood, metal, etc., that holds the material and rotates it about a horizontal axis against a tool that shapes it; a lathe.
example_en: The craftsman carved the wooden pillar on the lathe.

definition: a rushing or tendency to rush with impetus or violence.
example_en: The trees bent from the violent rush of the wind.

definition: to shine; to glow; to emit or reflect light; to be radiant.
example_en: The moon is shining in the sky.

definition: the cassia plant Cassia tora of Caesalpiniaceae family; foetid cassia.
example_en: The foetid cassia plant has spread across the open field.

definition: unaffected, childlike demeanour.
example_en: That child's unaffected, childlike demeanour attracted everyone.

definition: the act of walking with a lame or partially disabled leg; a limping.
example: ಗಾಯದ ಕಾಲಿನಿಂದಾಗಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕುಂಟು ನಡಿಗೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: Because of the injured leg, he began walking with a limp.

definition: a kind of percussion instrument.
example_en: They play the malara drum at that village's fair.

definition: a temporary suspension as of an activity or function; abeyance.
example_en: Due to the rain, there was a temporary suspension of work.

definition: the lawless, quarrelsome, scoundrel behaviour; rowdyism.
example_en: Seeing his rowdyism, the police came.

definition: a letter written in response to another's letter.
example: ನಾನು ಬರೆದ ಓಲೆಗೆ ಅವನು ಮಾರೋಲೆ ಬರೆದ.
example_en: He wrote a reply letter to the letter I had written.

definition: the state or condition of being deficient; deficiency.
example_en: Several deficiencies were found in that report.

definition: that attracts or has the power to attract; esp., pleasing; charming; pretty; attractive; beautiful.
example_en: Her charming smile attracted everyone.

definition: a huge rock; a boulder.
example_en: A huge boulder was seen by the side of the path.

definition: rain water.
example_en: Rain water fell well into the field.

definition: to bring down; to cause to come down.
example_en: The servants brought the bundle down from the bull's back.

definition: the chieftain of a mountainous region.
example_en: That chieftain ruled the mountainous region.

definition: a kind of ornament for the head.
example_en: The golden head ornament shone on the bride's head.

definition: that which is large or huge.
example_en: That rock of the hill is truly a huge thing.

definition: without a reason; without a cause; unintentionally.
example_en: He fell down without any reason and sprained his leg.

definition: with a sound as made by birds while flapping their wings.
example_en: The birds flew away flapping their wings with a fluttering sound.

definition: the quality or condition of being boundless, limitless.
example_en: The travellers were amazed at the boundlessness of the ocean.

definition: a speaking together; conversation; colloquy.
example_en: A good conversation took place between the two.

definition: (in pl.) the body and its parts.
example_en: His body and its parts were injured in the accident.

definition: the fact of being disloyal to or acting against the interest of, the country living in.
example_en: His disloyalty to the country brought disgrace to the whole town.

definition: a giving way; conceding; complying.
example_en: The agreement went through because of his giving way.

definition: a coercive behaviour or oppressive way of talking.
example: ಆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಯ ರೌಡು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That officer's coercive, oppressive manner frightened everyone.

definition: a thin, slender abdomen.
example_en: Due to fasting, his thin abdomen shrank even more.

definition: not sure of; not definite; uncertain.
example: ಈ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಇನ್ನೂ ಮಗುಂ ಆಗಿಯೇ ಇದೆ.
example_en: This result is still uncertain.

definition: got or getting without labouring for; without strain.
example_en: He got this money without any effort.

definition: the condition of a person who is scared of.
example: ಕಳ್ಳರ ಶಬ್ದ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೆದಱೆದೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the thieves' noise, he was overcome with fear.

definition: a small lamp, esp. votive lamp.
example: ದೇವರ ಮುಂದೆ ಕೈಸೊಡರು ಹಚ್ಚಿ ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She lit a small votive lamp before the deity and worshipped.

definition: the state or fact of being not molested, annoyed or harmed.
example_en: They lived peacefully in a state of being unmolested.

definition: the quality of being dishonest; dishonest behaviour; deceiving, stealing, etc.
example_en: His dishonest behavior was known to everyone.

definition: a song sung by women in chorus on auspicious occasions as marriage.
example_en: At the wedding, the women sang the sōvana song in chorus.

definition: a farm, agricultural estate situated close or adjacent to a forest.
example_en: His forest-adjacent farm is right next to the woods.

definition: a courageous, adventurous man.
example_en: That courageous man faced the tiger alone.

definition: a gem supposed to have and emit solar heat.
example: ಅಗ್ನಿಗರ್ಭವು ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬಿಸಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊರಸೂಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They say that the solar gem emits the heat of the sun.

definition: a kind of bird .
example: ಚಿನುಕುಲಿ ಪಕ್ಷಿ ಮರದ ಪೊಟರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೂಡು ಕಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The chinukuli bird had built its nest in the hollow of the tree.

definition: a person who assists or serves in a subordinate position; helper; an assistant.
example_en: He works as the minister's assistant.

definition: a finger.
example_en: She put the ring onto her finger.

definition: a passage for water.
example_en: The farmers gathered to build a water passage to the field.

definition: a hollow place in the stem or a branch of a tree.
example: ಆ ಆಲದ ಮರದ ಬುಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಳವಾದ ಡೊಂಗಱ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a deep hollow at the base of that banyan tree.

definition: the seed of Abrus precatorius used as a standard unit of weight.
example: ಅಕ್ಕಸಾಲಿಗ ಚಿನ್ನವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ರತಿ ತೂಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳೆದನು.
example_en: The goldsmith weighed the gold in a unit of one rati.

definition: to leave an agricultural farm or land without being cultivated.
example_en: Due to the drought, the farmer left the field uncultivated.

definition: a night that is absolutely dark.
example_en: On that pitch-dark night, no one went outside.

definition: a year in which comparatively more (land) revenue is received by the exchequer of a state.
example: ಈ ಬಾರಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮಳೆಯಿಂದಾಗಿ ಛಡಸಾಲ್ ವರ್ಷವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: This time, due to good rains, it became a year of high revenue.

definition: any fruit used as a vegetable.
example_en: She brought jackfruit used as a vegetable.

definition: a woman who elects; a qualified voter.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ನಿರ್ವಾಚಕಿ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ಮತ ಹಾಕಿದಳು.
example_en: The woman voter of that village cast her vote for the first time.

definition: the quality or state of being indulgently lenient; lenience.
example_en: The teacher's leniency was liked by the students.

definition: to go round (something) three times (usu. in clockwise).
example_en: The devotees went around the temple three times and offered worship.

definition: a big boulder.
example_en: A big boulder stood in the way in the middle of the field.

definition: comfortably; conveniently.
example_en: He is living comfortably in the new house.

definition: loved very much; most beloved.
example_en: She was his most beloved wife.

definition: the act or process of inoculating; esp. the injection of a disease agent into an animal or plant, usually to cause a mild form of the disease and build up immunity to it; inoculation.
example_en: The doctors gave the children a protective inoculation.

definition: (vegetation) to grow profusely; to be raised luxuriantly.
example_en: In the rainy season, the plants grew profusely.

definition: a woman who is protected, guarded by another.
example_en: She grew up protected and guarded by her father.

definition: a confluence of three things, rivers, roads, etc.
example: ಮೂರು ರಸ್ತೆಗಳ ಮುಕೂಡಲ್ ಬಳಿ ಒಂದು ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a temple near the confluence of the three roads.

definition: any substance used to give certain flavour; a flavouring.
example_en: She mixed a flavouring into the cooking.

definition: the fact of being famous; fame.
example: ಆ ಕವಿಯ ವಿದಿತ ಇಡೀ ನಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That poet's fame had spread throughout the land.

definition: a deficiency in the quantity; shortage; deficit.
example_en: A shortage of rice was found in the warehouse.

definition: a school for infants in which object lessons and games feature.
example_en: The little children go to the anganawadi every day.

definition: a carriage drawn by a pair of either horses or oxen.
example_en: The bride came to the village sitting in a carriage drawn by a pair of horses.

definition: (pros.) a meter.
example: ಈ ಕವಿತೆಯನ್ನು ಕುಸುಮವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಎಂಬ ಛಂದಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರಚಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This poem is composed in the meter called kusumavicitra.

definition: an increase; a growth; opulence.
example: ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಬೇಸಾಯದಿಂದ ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಕೊರ್ಬು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Through good farming, that family's prosperity increased.

definition: not equal; unequal.
example_en: Those two weights are unequal.

definition: an archaic monetary coin (minted at Panāḷa).
example: ಅಜ್ಜನ ಬಳಿ ಹಳೆಯ ಪನಾಳಿ ಒಂದು ಉಳಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: My grandfather still has an old Panali coin with him.

definition: that which happened in ancient time immemorial.
example_en: No one knows the ancient origin of this temple.

definition: greater in amount, degree or number; more.
example_en: He wants more money.

definition: in spite of; despite.
example: ಅಂತೂ ಮಳೆಯ ಆದರೂ ಅವರು ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Despite the rain, they continued their journey.

definition: three times.
example_en: He repeated that statement three times.

definition: a variety of millet grass.
example_en: The farmers grew jōgi jeḍe millet grass as fodder for cattle.

definition: to be excited from joy.
example_en: The students were excited with joy on hearing the result.

definition: to sharpen by rubbing, grinding or honing.
example_en: The carpenter sharpened the chisel.

definition: an unconfirmed report, story or statement in general circulation; a rumour.
example_en: It is not known how true that rumour is.

definition: to do something.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಏಗುವುದು ಎಂದು ಅವನಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He did not know how to do this work.

definition: the using of energy to get something done; exertion of strength or mental power; effort; endeavour.
example_en: He put in great effort to reach the goal.
